name: Create Payment Method
description: Create Payment Method Creates a new payment method for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods
Creates a new payment method for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Payment Method
description: Delete Payment Method Deletes a payment method from an account. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods/{payment_method_id}

name: Get Payment Method
description: Get Payment Method Gets a specific payment method for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods/{payment_method_id}

name: List Payment Methods
description: List Payment Methods Lists all payment methods for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods
Lists all payment methods for an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query)

name: Set Default Payment Method
description: Set Default Payment Method Sets a payment method as the default for an account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods/{payment_method_id}/set-as-default
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods/{payment_method_id}/set-as-default
Sets a payment method as the default for an account.
Required: account_id (path); payment_method_id (path) — Payment method identifier.

name: Update Payment Method
description: Update Payment Method Updates a payment method for an account. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/payment-methods/{payment_method_id}
